steps.name: Sample structure QC (paired design)
steps.question: Do the 10 blood samples (5 subjects x control/treated) cluster by subject and/or by condition, and are library sizes and sample identities consistent with the stated pairing in metadata.csv?

grounding.reason: R-0033: run blind-vst PCA + sample distance heatmap before any paired model, since a mislabeled subject/condition would invalidate the ~subject+condition design.

acceptance_criteria: Blind VST computed on the full count matrix (12000 genes x 10 samples)
PCA on top 500 variable genes colored by condition and by subject is produced
Sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap produced
Library size per sample reported; any sample far below the median flagged
Report states whether samples cluster by subject (expected for a paired design) and whether any sample appears mislabeled or an outlier

steps.name: Low-count filtering
steps.question: Which of the 12,000 genes have adequate counts to be tested given 5 samples per condition?

grounding.reason: Minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, the smaller group size); independent filtering in the results step handles the rest.

acceptance_criteria: Genes with fewer than 10 counts in at least 5 samples (the smallest group size) removed
Number of genes retained after filtering reported

steps.name: Paired DESeq2 differential expression (treated vs control, blocked on subject)
steps.question: Within each of the 5 subjects, which genes are differentially expressed between the treated and control blood samples, after removing between-subject variation?

grounding.reason: Paired design blocked on subject (~subject+condition) per R-0011; DESeq2 Wald + apeglm per R-0001/R-0009; explicit reference level per R-0036; internal median-of-ratios normalization per R-0026; report Cook's-distance NA flags per R-0039 (n=5 per group, below the 7-replicate replace threshold).

acceptance_criteria: DESeq2 fit with design ~ subject + condition, condition releveled with control as the explicit reference level
Median-of-ratios size factors used (no pre-normalized counts fed into the model)
Wald test performed on the condition coefficient (treated vs control)
apeglm shrinkage applied to the treated-vs-control log2 fold change; unshrunken LFC retained alongside the shrunken value
Count outlier flags (Cook's distance) from DESeq2 reported separately from independent-filtering NAs
Results table includes gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange (shrunken and raw), lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj

steps.name: Significance calling (BH-adjusted, independent filtering)
steps.question: Which genes are called significantly responsive to treatment at FDR < 0.05, within the paired design?

grounding.reason: BH FDR at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering; selection by padj only, per R-0010/R-0043.

acceptance_criteria: results() called with alpha = 0.05 matching the reporting cutoff, independent filtering left on
Genes selected by padj < 0.05, not by raw p-value or fold change alone
Number of genes tested after filtering and number of DE genes at padj<0.05 reported
Final DE gene table (padj-sorted) exported as CSV

steps.name: Preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark
steps.question: Which biological pathways (MSigDB Hallmark) are coordinately altered by treatment across the within-subject Wald-statistic ranking of all tested genes?

grounding.reason: Human dataset: Hallmark first per R-0048; full-list preranked fgsea per R-0045; disputed ranking-statistic side chosen as Wald stat per R-0007; size window 15-500 per R-0047; collapse redundant sets per R-0052. Reference store currently reports no provisioned collections (checked via list_available_refs), so the step is written to verify presence at run time and degrade to an explicit skip rather than fail silently or substitute the wrong resource.

acceptance_criteria: Full ranked list of all genes tested in T1S3 (not thresholded) ranked by DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column), ties broken deterministically

fgsea run against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets for Homo sapiens if present in the reference store; if the Hallmark collection is not found in the environment's reference data, the step reports this explicitly and skips enrichment rather than substituting an unrelated or wrong-organism gene set collection
Gene sets restricted to 15-500 members among tested genes
BH-adjusted enrichment p-values reported; redundant/overlapping significant sets collapsed to representative sets with full table kept as supplement
Ranking statistic choice (Wald stat) stated explicitly in the output

steps.name: Consolidated report
steps.question: What is the reproducible summary of within-subject treatment response in this 5-subject paired blood cohort — methods, thresholds, gene counts, and pathway-level findings?

grounding.reason: Report must include full reproducibility fields (R-0041), enrichment database/version/metric/universe/window (R-0051), and a caveat that enrichment method choice affects results (R-0055).

acceptance_criteria: Report states: design formula (~subject+condition), reference level (control), test (DESeq2 Wald), shrinkage (apeglm), FDR method (BH) and alpha (0.05), package versions, session info
Reports number of genes tested after filtering and number of DE genes at padj<0.05, plus any Cook's-distance-flagged genes with NA p-values
Reports the enrichment gene-set database and version (or explicit statement that enrichment was skipped due to missing reference), ranking metric, universe, and size window used
States explicitly that enrichment results are method-dependent and are a hypothesis for follow-up, not a proven finding
Top DE genes (by padj) and top enriched Hallmark pathways (if run) summarized in tables

plan.title: Paired within-subject DESeq2 treatment response, 5 subjects
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12,000 x 10 raw STAR/featureCounts gene counts from 5 human blood subjects, each contributing a paired control and treated sample. The research question ('which genes respond to treatment within each subject') is a paired/blocked design question, so the analysis blocks on subject and tests condition within-subject with DESeq2 (design ~ subject + condition), per rule R-0011 from the knowledge service. The flow is: (1) QC to confirm pairing/sample structure and rule out an outlier subject or sample-swap before trusting the paired model; (2) minimal count pre-filter; (3) DESeq2 normalization + paired Wald test for treated-vs-control with apeglm shrinkage; (4) BH-adjusted significance calling with independent filtering; (5) preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark on the Wald statistic to characterize the pathways the responding genes belong to; (6) a consolidated report with all required reproducibility fields. All steps are grounded in the knowledge service's full_plan procedure for a paired 2-group human bulk RNA-seq counts design (5 vs 5, star_featurecounts, no other batch), snapshot sha256:833150c5e45cf8a541b59ec599683b486b4c93e5c3fdba069dfabb107e66da2c.

steps.method: keep gene with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark
summary report with methods, versions, thresholds, DE counts, enrichment
